import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "61ffe358c866c419b4af7f369f6446eed3f072f7"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch}")

cli = wt / "src/do_again/cli.py"
text = cli.read_text()
if "from .browser import cdp\n" not in text:
    anchor = "from .platforms.detect import detect_platform\n"
    if anchor not in text:
        raise SystemExit("cdp import anchor missing")
    text = text.replace(anchor, "from .browser import cdp\n" + anchor, 1)
cli.write_text(text)

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt / "src")

run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"], env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused = run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_cli"], check=False, env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc=" + str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"])
commit = run(["git","commit","-m","Add end-to-end setup verification command"], check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
